You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To join the soccer team, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase professional-grade soccer cleats (45 minutes)
Step 2. Attend the mandatory team orientation meeting (1 hour)
Step 3. Practice penalty kicks at the local park (2 hours)
Step 4. Submit the final athletic department registration (15 minutes)
Step 5. Join the team group chat for schedule updates (10 minutes)
Step 6. Complete a basic cardiovascular endurance test (30 minutes)
Step 7. Attend the first official team practice session (2 hours)
Step 8. Obtain a signed medical clearance from a physician (2 days)
Step 9. Order the customized team home and away jerseys (2 weeks)
Step 10. Schedule a physical examination appointment (10 minutes)
Step 11. Research local soccer clubs and tryout dates (1 hour)
Step 12. Buy a high-quality soccer ball for individual drills (30 minutes)
Step 13. Register for the regional skills development clinic (20 minutes)
Step 14. Pick up the team uniform from the sports shop (30 minutes)
Step 15. Watch instructional videos on defensive positioning (1 hour)
Step 16. Complete the online skills clinic modules (4 hours)
Step 17. Pay the seasonal team participation fees (15 minutes)
Step 18. Practice dribbling through cones in the backyard (1 hour)
Step 19. Review the official team playbook and formations (3 hours)
Step 20. Perform a series of agility ladder drills (45 minutes)
Step 21. Purchase shin guards and tall athletic socks (30 minutes)
Step 22. Attend a seminar on sports nutrition and hydration (90 minutes)
Step 23. Participate in a weekend scrimmage match (2 hours)
Step 24. Submit the initial tryout interest form (5 minutes)
Step 25. Watch professional soccer matches to study movement (2 hours)
Step 26. Visit the local sporting goods store (20 minutes)
Step 27. Pass the technical ball-handling assessment (1 hour)
Step 28. Search for upcoming soccer clinics in the area (15 minutes)
Step 29. Receive the official player ID card (1 week)
Step 30. Review the team’s code of conduct and ethics (30 minutes)
Step 31. Set up a personal training schedule (1 hour)
Step 32. Verify insurance coverage for sports injuries (1 day)
Step 33. Consult with a fitness coach about goals (45 minutes)
Step 34. Sign the liability waiver for the training facility (10 minutes)
Step 35. Receive the tryout invitation email (1 day)
Step 36. Label all personal gear with permanent marker (15 minutes)
Step 37. Get a baseline concussion screening (1 hour)
Step 38. Participate in the formal tryout evaluations (3 days)
Step 39. Break in the new soccer cleats (5 days)
Step 40. Attend a pre-season conditioning camp (1 week)
Step 41. Watch film of the team's previous season (4 hours)
Step 42. Complete a 5-mile timed run (40 minutes)
Step 43. Interview with the head coach (30 minutes)
Step 44. Log into the player performance portal (5 minutes)
Step 45. Pack the gear bag for the upcoming season (20 minutes)
Step 46. Finalize the player emergency contact list (10 minutes)
Step 47. Gather all required identification documents (1 hour)
Step 48. Wash and prepare the practice gear (1 hour)
Step 49. Receive the official roster spot confirmation (2 days)
Step 50. Download the team's video analysis software (20 minutes)
